item.title: Starting again after years away
item.description: A Denver music teacher on coming back to an instrument as an adult: why the love goes dormant, what the restart really looks like, and how lessons help it stick.

item.title: Am I too old to learn an instrument?
item.description: A Denver music teacher on learning an instrument as an adult: what the research says about age, what actually stops adults, and how lessons built for adults work.
